description: Returns a page of NFL players (player_id, name, position, team), optionally for one position, paged with next_cursor. Use it to browse a position group; to find a specific player, search_players is faster. Free plan.

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous page; omit for the first page.
cursor.title: Cursor

position.description: Only this position. Pro keys can also list offensive linemen with C, G or OT.
position.title: Position

name: list_players

error.description: Present only when the call failed: what went wrong.

next_cursor.description: Pass back as cursor for the next page; absent on the last page.

note.description: A sentence for the user saying which plan is needed.

players.description: One page of players with their player_id, name, position and team.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure reason, e.g. basic_required or pro_required.

required_plan.description: The plan that unlocks this data: basic or pro.

status.description: HTTP status of the failed API call.
